title: Brown used ion-wind work to cover for electrogravitics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Brown used ion-wind work to cover for electrogravitics, about mid-20th century at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And the funny thing is Brown himself would use the electrohydrodnamic stuff the the stuff involving ion wind to cover for the electrogravitics

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown used his work on ion wind, the push of air caused by electrically charged particles, as a cover story for his real interest, electrogravitics, the idea that electricity can affect gravity. If true, it would mean Brown deliberately hid his more radical research behind a more ordinary explanation.
